set.body:
Demonstrate the complete chain from events and observations through relation plan and fit into plan_geometry, RDM, RSA, and admitted uncertainty.

Acceptance: parity with legacy lm_relation_fit on the same raw data; coding-invariant plans across two parameterizations; unequal partitions, confounds, censoring, and fixed versus learned observation models exercised; direct linear-algebra oracle for E and B; downstream point and covariance parity; negative fixtures for misalignment, non-estimability, undeclared independence, and unearned analytic uncertainty.

The evidence must use a versioned multi-run fixture and report runtime and memory for every new public execution path.
set.title: Phase 5: Certify an end-to-end raw-observation vertical slice
